# state/ — final-state files (model: apply-from-final)

One tool applies everything from final state into the game. Per-change delta
files are **not** build inputs — they remain in git as edit history /
provenance only.

## Files (generated by a build script; this dir is the single apply input)

| file | content |
|---|---|
| `final_assets.json` | every asset string field that differs from untouched source: asset path, field id, JP original, EN final |
| `final_dll_map.json` | every changed managed-DLL literal, **IL-level ground truth**: unique (JP,EN) pairs + changed positions (decompile text is provenance only — escape sequences and interpolated fragments differ from IL literals) |
| `final_toplevel.json` | install-tree operations outside the game data dir (remove mod loader dirs, config flips, file adds/removes) |

## Rules

- **Generated, never hand-edited**: derived from the catalog joined against
  untouched-source extracts; re-run regenerates byte-identical output.
- **Self-test before writing**: e.g. run the patcher on a copy of the
  untouched DLL and assert the output hash equals the deployed hash.
- **Frozen evidence gates** (re-verified against live files on every run):
  entry counts, unique-pair counts, changed-position counts, and SHA256 of
  every source file the state is pinned to.
